title: Apply ingredient substitutions once and simultaneously
description: The pantry.py planner can substitute ingredient names before quantity planning. A duplicated mapping pass turns a single selected replacement into a second replacement. Repair substitute_items(items, replacements). items is a list of at most 100 Unicode strings; replacements is a mapping of at most 100 Unicode string keys to Unicode string values. Empty strings, repeated names, self-replacements and cycles in the map are supported. Exact string equality is used; no case or Unicode normalization occurs. None/null and all other shapes are outside this retained contract.

requirements.text: At each original input position whose string is a replacement key, emit that key's direct mapped value exactly once. Preserve positions and duplicates; a mapped value must not be looked up again, even when it is itself a key.
At positions whose original string is absent from replacements, emit the original string unchanged, including case and Unicode composition. An empty items list returns [].
Leave both the items list and the replacements mapping unchanged in content, including when one or more names are replaced.

provenance: Original independent AI-authored batch-preparation library; author job repo05, repository owned-v2-r05; CC0-1.0. No upstream code or data.
